protocol: Three graphs are built from each fitting fold: tags joined by shared products, tags joined to the taxonomy paths of their products, and title battles directed from loser to winner. Degree, strength, PageRank with damping 0.85, leading eigenvector and unweighted betweenness give a score for every tag. Tags are sorted by each score in both directions, with ties to the larger tag and then the tag name, and each order is fitted as a priority list with cell medoids, backfilled cell medoids and pooled values. Taxonomy association and five random orders are refitted as references. Folds have equal weight.
